t.E420.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E420.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E420.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E420.eff.1.a: Above 50 g a day; not seen at 25 g a day taken in two doses
t.E420.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; it is avoided in a sensitive-gut (FODMAP) diet.
t.E420.prod: It is obtained from sugar or starch by hydrogenation (a chemical process).
t.E420.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E420.summary: A polyol (sugar alcohol) produced from glucose. It is used as a sweetener and humectant in sugar-free chewing gum, confectionery and cake; it occurs naturally in some fruits.
t.E420.what: It is a sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
